definitions.explanation: The nut of the walnut tree, or the tree itself. Walnuts are commonly used in Japanese cooking and baking, and are a traditional ingredient in dishes like くるみ餅 and various sweets.

examples.japanese: {胡桃|くるみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{砕|くだ}いて→砕く：03920_kudaku⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I crushed some walnuts and put them in the salad.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{胡桃|くるみ}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This walnut bread is very popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{胡桃|くるみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The walnut tree in the garden bore a lot of fruit again this year.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana as くるみ in everyday contexts. The kanji {胡桃|くるみ} appears in product names, menus, and written materials. The kanji {胡|こ} means "barbarian" (referring to its origin from China/the West) and ⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧ means "peach" — literally "foreign peach."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胡桃|くるみ}{割|わ}り: nutcracker
- {胡桃|くるみ}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧: walnut bread
- {胡桃|くるみ}{餅|もち}: walnut mochi
- {胡桃|くるみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}→殻：02148_kara⟧: walnut shell
